# Show and Type & show

Show puts your message on the whole screen in large, clear text, so the other person can read it easily.

## Type & show

1. On the home screen, tap **Start typing**.
2. Type your message.
3. Tap **Show**.

Use this for anything you haven't saved as a template. To show a template instead, see [Templates](templates.md).

## While it's showing

- **Change colours** switches between black on white, white on black, and yellow on black. Choose the one that's easiest to read in the light you're in. You can set the starting colours in [Settings](settings.md).
- **Continue as chat** opens a chat with your message in it, so the other person can reply. See [Side by side](side-by-side.md).
- Swipe down to go back.
